later_depositors_received_worthless_shar.meaning: later depositors bought shares that are worthless and their funds were effectively stolen

assumptions: The vault's share supply should be zero whenever the vault holds zero underlying assets.

unresolved.description: The intent 'start with zero supply and mint shares only when assets exist' is a minting-condition requirement, not a supply-equals-assets correspondence; the correspondence pattern cannot faithfully encode 'mint only when assets exist' without inventing a minting relation.
Report does not define the exact share-mint formula operands, so the 'worthless shares' magnitude cannot be expressed numerically.

limitations: V is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric share-value or loss magnitude for later depositors.

The correspondence pattern's condition/observed/expected slots are a best-effort encoding of the frozen intent; the post-generation fidelity audit should assess whether the intent is representable at all.
